title: LOW TIDE
hook: the sea went out|and did not come back
style: cinematic film still, anamorphic, dramatic contrast, moody practical lighting, rich shadows, filmic grain, high detail

music.tags: desolate solo piano, distant strings, loss, very sparse, instrumental

beats.prompt: A harbour at low tide with boats resting on wet mud, grey morning light, wide shot, still
beats.motion: Water trickles in the channels. A boat settles slightly.
beats.caption: Twice a day, like clockwork

line.text: The tide goes out twice a day. Everyone here knows the timing by heart.

beats.prompt: A close-up of a stopped harbour clock, salt-corroded face, hard light, high detail
beats.motion: The clock hands do not move. Light shifts across the face.
beats.caption: On Wednesday it did not come back

line.text: On Tuesday it went out at nine. On Wednesday it did not come back.

beats.prompt: A vast expanse of exposed seabed stretching to the horizon, strange and wide, cold light, no water
beats.motion: Mist drifts slowly across the seabed.
beats.caption: There is a road down there

line.text: There is a road down there. There was never a road down there.

beats.sfx: a low wind across open flats

beats.prompt: A distant figure walking out along the exposed seabed, tiny in the frame, wide shot, cinematic
beats.motion: The figure walks slowly away into the mist.
